items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: You did some writing for Duke Ellington, too, didn't you? ... I did a special arrangement for Duke on William Tell.

ctx.x: Yes. And here's -- we had on the bill a dance team called the Four Blazers. That was formerly with Duke Ellington's band. Well, Duke played that week, so they
held the Four Blazers over because Duke was off. Duke laid off a week. And when Duke laid off a week, we came in and we played the Pearl Theater that week the Duke was off. This was back into '31.
